content.title: Market Skids, But This Stock Didn't Get The Memo. It's Up 9% This Week.
content.summary: Why is diesel-engine maker Cummins up 9% this week, while the S&P 500 suffers its worst week since April?  Cummins reported a 2% drop in sales to $8.3 billion and a 34% slide in earnings to $3.86 a share.  Columbus, Ind.-based Cummins also warned that lower hydrogen adoption is forcing the company to conduct a strategic review of its electrolyzer business, CEO Jennifer Rumsey said.
